To find the time constant for a person standing on a ground plane, we use the formula for the time constant of an RC circuit:

\[ \tau = R \times C \]

Given:
- Resistance \( R = 1000 \, \text{M}\Omega = 1000 \times 10^6 \, \Omega = 10^9 \, \Omega \)
- Capacitance \( C = 150 \, \text{pF} = 150 \times 10^{-12} \, \text{F} \)

Calculating the time constant:

\[ \tau = 10^9 \, \Omega \times 150 \times 10^{-12} \, \text{F} \]
\[ \tau = 150 \times 10^{-3} \, \text{s} \]
\[ \tau = 0.15 \, \text{s} = 150 \, \text{ms} \]

The calculated time constant is 150 ms.
